evals.name: protected pr ci satisfies gate
evals.prompt: Use the release skill. A release PR was merged into protected `main`. Branch protection required the `validate` PR check, and GitHub allowed the merge only after `validate` passed. The repository workflow has only `pull_request`; there is no push-to-main workflow and no manual dispatch. Produce the release status line for the CI gate and state whether tagging may proceed if version, changelog, and tag rules match.
evals.expected_output: The response includes `Required CI gate status:` and identifies the gate as protected PR CI. It says there is no separate post-merge main workflow to wait for and allows tagging if version, changelog, and tag rules match.
assertions: The output includes the exact label `Required CI gate status:`.
The output identifies the gate as `protected PR CI`.
The output says no separate post-merge main workflow exists or no separate main run is required.
The output allows proceeding to tag if version, changelog, and tag rules match.
The output does not say tagging must stop solely because the merge commit has no separate main CI status.

evals.name: post merge main ci required when present
evals.prompt: Use the release skill. A release PR merged after green PR checks. The repository also has a separate `push` workflow on `main` that runs release validation after merges. The push workflow for the merged release commit is still pending. May the agent tag now?
evals.expected_output: The response rejects tagging while the separate post-merge main workflow is pending and requires that workflow to pass for the merged release commit first.
assertions: The output says not to tag yet.
The output identifies the separate post-merge main workflow as part of the required CI gate.
The output requires the push-to-main workflow to pass for the merged release commit.
The output does not treat the green PR check alone as sufficient when a separate main workflow exists and is pending.
